blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A budget watchdog on Tuesday expressed concern that changes to the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027 are already being negotiated behind closed doors, as it warned that any subsequent public hearings may be viewed as merely for show. The House of Representatives has entered the final stages of its budget process after wrapping up floor debates on the P7.2-trillion budget bill last week. And proposed amendments are expected to be introduced in the spending plan by lawmakers, with any potential changes to be handled by a sub-committee of ranking legislators before being voted on the floor on […]...
